name: open meeting history panel and verify dismiss buttons

actions.comment: Was a bare goto plus a click on the text 'Meetings'. Two things had rotted: the page is behind the auth + setup gates now, and 'Meetings' is the *label inside* the history panel (`.hist-head-label`), not something that opens it. The panel is opened from the hq-bar View menu.

expect: The Meetings panel toggle is checked in the hq-bar View menu. When the office has recorded meetings the history panel is open with rows; each completed/failed row shows an X button to dismiss it and the header shows 'Clear N read'. With no meetings recorded the panel stays hidden — it only renders when the list is non-empty.
